policy: Uniform arm-blind exact-text grammar, coherence, scientific quality and public-source fidelity review. Anchor claim preservation is separate and does not change the intrinsic approval rubric. Garbling, unsupported causal changes and material public-source deletions fail. Uncertain remains unapproved. No silent repair or coverage-driven relaxation; individual review is not an accuracy estimate or correctness certificate.
